title: Nagata’s conjecture for plane curves
checkingScope: Theorem 1.1 and the proof passages in Sections 2–6 read, including every principal reduction. This is editorial source comparison, not independent validation of the entire proof.

statements.hypotheses: For each integer r>=10, distinct ordered points in P2_C outside one countable union E_r of proper closed subsets with nonempty complement; all nonzero effective forms of degree d>=1 and all mi>=0 integral bounded by actual multiplicities.
statements.conclusion: d sqrt(r)>sum mi, simultaneously for all degrees and vectors, including reducible and nonreduced curves.

statements.hypotheses: Uncountable algebraically closed k of characteristic zero; r>=10.
statements.conclusion: Same simultaneous strict inequality outside a countable union of proper closed subsets of ordered distinct tuples, nonempty complement.
statements.checking: Rational minors and algebraic independence argument read.

statements.hypotheses: Blowup at a tuple covered by Theorem 1.1 or Corollary 6.1.
statements.conclusion: N_r=sqrt(r)H-sum Ei is strictly nef, N_r^2=0, and equal-weight multipoint epsilon(O(1);p_i)=1/sqrt(r).
statements.checking: All three conclusions and separate upper/lower bounds read.

proofPassages.read: Closed incidence loci, cyclic products, arbitrary normal displacement, nonzero initial coefficient and preservation of multiplicities.
Non-torsion bundles and evaluation cokernel, endpoint d=km, cubic exclusion d<=3m.
Removal of nine zeros, theta multiplier choices, analytic cubic embedding, coefficient spaces and fixed charts.
Fixed-curve collision, unit-normalized coefficient subsequence, Rouche, normal convergence, exponent set including zero-degree block, minor persistence.
Row interpolation, contracted polygon, endpoint errors, common powers before limits, final contradiction.
Base change of Q-minors, strict nefness, zero square, dimension-count upper bound.
